AutoSpace 0.5.0-beta.19 is the nineteenth public beta — a prerelease, on the beta line.

## New features
- Crimson Rain + Ember, a second cyberpunk theme: signal red and measured teal on near-black, with squared slab buttons, rocker switches, a red-ring play button, and red mono headers. Dark only. Pick it in Settings, under Pairs.

## Improvements
- Shard, reworked: real hazard stripes on delete buttons, a true red-cyan-white glitch on press, a machined chrome edge, scanlines that fade down the card, a redline cap on the LED bar, and real values — counts and states — where the hash readouts were. The floating media card takes the theme frame when it has no album art.

## Bug fixes
- Various bug fixes and stability improvements.

## Maintenance
- No maintenance changes in this release.
